title: Echo Cave
tagline: Chirp in the dark and let the echoes draw the cave.
how_to: Hold and drag to fly, tap to chirp (or use the button); turn sound on and wear headphones.
description: You are a bat in a pitch-black cave. Every chirp sends out a ring whose echoes light the walls where it hits and sound from the side they bounce back from. Hidden fireflies answer your call with a chime; fly into each one to move on to a deeper, new cave.
spark: Took 'echo' literally: sonar echoes delayed by distance, plus fireflies that echo your call back in song.
proud_of: Echo timing is physical: farther walls light up and sound later, panned to the side they came from.
